screens.name: Home
screens.description: Dashboard: greeting and ring sync status, readiness hero with a one-line insight, sleep/activity score cards, a single Vitals list, and the Trends link. Detail (sparklines, ranges) is disclosed on each metric screen. Empty state shows the Connect your ring card before the first sync.
notes: Values come from the repo design-loop seed (scripts/seed-dataset.ts) folded through the app selectors; temp is in the collecting state (1 recorded night).
implementationHints: apps/mobile/src/app/index.tsx. Screen gap is spacing.gridGap (9); cards enter with FadeInDown at 40/80/160/240/320 ms.

sections.name: Header
sections.description: Top bar with the ring status line (dot + regular 12pt) and icon-only Sync / Ring glass buttons; then a medium 13pt date eyebrow and a 34pt light greeting whose second clause is semibold and carries today's state (readiness status, or 'let's connect your ring' before the first sync).
implementationHints: Weight hierarchy: status 400 · date 500 · greeting 300 with a 600 emphasis clause. Status text: Not connected / Syncing… / Connecting… / Sync failed — <reason> / Synced <rel> / Not synced yet, with a 6pt dot colored faint / sage / terracotta / sage deep / faint.

uses.reason: Sync now and Manage ring actions.

sections.name: Connect Card
sections.description: Before the first sync: a full-height sage card that fills the space under the greeting — ring illustration, 'Three quick steps to pair', one sentence, and a full-width Set up my ring button that opens the /pair journey.
notes: Proposed: replaces the single Connect card; the button leads into /pair step 1 instead of scanning immediately.

sections.name: Readiness Hero
sections.description: Tappable readiness ring (→ /readiness) with a status pill (Optimal ≥ 85, Good ≥ 70, else Recover) and one plain-language insight line drawn from the weakest contributor.
notes: Insight line is a proposed addition: it summarises the lowest readiness contributor against its baseline so the home screen answers 'how am I doing' before any chart.

sections.name: Sleep & Activity
sections.description: Sleep and activity score cards, each with one supporting fact (time asleep, calories vs goal). Charts live on the detail screens.

sections.name: Vitals
sections.description: One grouped card listing HRV, resting heart rate, body temperature and blood oxygen as rows: glyph, name, when measured, latest value, chevron. Sparklines and ranges are disclosed on each /metric screen instead of on home.
notes: Replaces the four vitals tiles; the body-temperature row carries its baseline-building hint in place of a timestamp.
implementationHints: Rows are pressable (→ /metric/hrv, /metric/rhr, /metric/temp, /metric/spo2) with a hairline between rows; minimum row height 60.

sections.name: Trends Link
sections.description: Row linking to /trends with a ring glyph in a 36pt glass circle.

screens.name: Pair Ring
screens.description: Ring setup and management, read left to right as one journey: three guided steps (used with Oura? → free the ring → place on charger), then scanning, no rings, results, connecting and paired.
notes: Ring id 5E1A7C and RSSI −58 dBm are sample device content (not in the seed); the ring name is the seed ringDeviceName.
implementationHints: apps/mobile/src/app/pair.tsx. Screen gap is spacing.gridGap (9). While a ring connects, other rows dim to 0.4 (ring-row dimmed).

sections.name: Header
sections.description: Back button and "Pair your ring" title.

sections.name: Step 1 · Used with Oura?
sections.description: Penna step: phone-to-ring illustration and a two-way choice — used with the Oura app goes to step 2, new or already reset skips to step 3.
notes: Proposed setup step ahead of scanning; grounded in docs/bdd/ring-connection.feature (onboarded rings must be factory-reset; stale iOS bonds must be removed in Settings → Bluetooth).

sections.name: Step 2 · Free the ring
sections.description: Periwinkle step: unlink illustration and a three-item checklist (remove in Oura, forget in Settings → Bluetooth, Kore resets on discovery); secondary opens Bluetooth settings.
notes: Proposed setup step ahead of scanning; grounded in docs/bdd/ring-connection.feature (onboarded rings must be factory-reset; stale iOS bonds must be removed in Settings → Bluetooth).

sections.name: Step 3 · On the charger
sections.description: Hudson step: ring-on-charger illustration; single Find my ring action starts the scan.
notes: Proposed setup step ahead of scanning; grounded in docs/bdd/ring-connection.feature (onboarded rings must be factory-reset; stale iOS bonds must be removed in Settings → Bluetooth).

sections.name: Debug Link
sections.description: Faint link to /ring-debug.

binding.copy: Having trouble? Open the debug console →

sections.name: Your Ring
sections.description: Paired ring card: badge, short id, Paired pill, Read ring info action, Forget this ring link.
implementationHints: After Read ring info succeeds, Battery / Firmware / Serial rows (12pt muted label, 12pt semibold ink value) appear under the header row; failures show 12pt peach-deep text.

uses.reason: Paired status and Read ring info action.

sections.name: Pair Different Ring
sections.description: Centered link that reveals the Nearby rings card while paired.

sections.name: Nearby Rings
sections.description: Scan card: header with scanning progress, discovered ring rows, hint or Rescan, and the no-rings empty state.
implementationHints: Error phase replaces the list with the BLE error (12pt peach-deep, centered) and a mint Try again pill. Pair errors add Retry pairing, and for set_auth_key failures a peach Factory-reset ring pill.

screens.name: Readiness
screens.description: Readiness detail: 170pt score ring with the delta against the 7-day night-backed average, and the six contributor bars. Empty state before any synced day.
notes: Values from the design-loop seed folded through the app selectors.
implementationHints: apps/mobile/src/app/readiness.tsx. Readiness is TREND-only: the whole screen stays empty until maturity.readiness is ready.

sections.name: Header
sections.description: Back button, title, and day stamp (plain in the empty state).

sections.name: Score
sections.description: Lightning badge, readiness ring with "Today", and the vs 7-day average pill (hidden when there is no prior night-backed day).

sections.name: Contributors
sections.description: HRV Balance, Body Temp, Sleep, Resting HR, Recovery, Activity Bal — peach under 0.75.

sections.name: Empty State
sections.description: EmptyDataCard before the first sync.
implementationHints: When a day exists but has no night data, the title is MATURITY_COPY.readiness.none ("Wear your ring tonight") and the message MATURITY_COPY.readiness.empty.

stateMapping.empty: today == null or readiness not ready

screens.name: Sleep
screens.description: Sleep detail, summary first: score and time asleep with efficiency and latency; stage breakdown; the stage timeline; then overnight heart rate and HRV, each on its own full-width card.
notes: Values from the design-loop seed folded through the app selectors (seed sleep window is shifted to daytime clock hours by the seed clock anchor).
implementationHints: apps/mobile/src/app/sleep.tsx.

sections.name: Header
sections.description: Back button, title, and night date.

sections.name: Summary
sections.description: Brand (Penna) summary: sleep score ring and time asleep with the sleep window, then efficiency and time-to-fall-asleep as two plain figures under a hairline.

sections.name: Stages
sections.description: White card: stage proportion bar, then a 2×2 legend giving each stage's duration and share of the night.

sections.name: Timeline
sections.description: White card: hypnogram across the sleep window with stage rows and three clock ticks; disclosed after the stage summary.
implementationHints: Only rendered when the night has usable HR staging; a duration-only night hides this card and the breakdown.

sections.name: Heart Rate & HRV
sections.description: Two full-width cards (Penna heart rate, sage HRV), each: heading, the overnight low/peak figure with its unit, and a full-width sparkline with three clock ticks.
implementationHints: Sparklines are interactive in the app (tap/drag scrubbing tooltip with clock time).

sections.name: Empty State
sections.description: EmptyDataCard before a tracked night.

screens.name: Activity
screens.description: Activity detail, summary first: score and active calories against goal with steps and distance; the day's movement chart; inactive time; the 7-day line — each a full-width card.
notes: Values from the design-loop seed folded through the app selectors.
implementationHints: apps/mobile/src/app/activity.tsx.

sections.name: Header
sections.description: Back button, title, and day stamp.

sections.name: Summary
sections.description: Brand (Hudson) summary: activity score ring beside active calories with progress toward the calorie goal; steps and distance as two figures under a hairline.
implementationHints: Steps and KM are never measured by the ring — hardcoded 0, not estimates.

sections.name: Movement
sections.description: White card: movement bar chart for the day with the Day / Week / Month range control beneath the chart it scopes.

sections.name: Inactive time
sections.description: Brand (periwinkle) card: inactive time with the inactivity-alert state. The calorie goal now lives in the summary.

sections.name: Last 7 days
sections.description: White card: heading with the weekly average, full-width 7-day activity line.

sections.name: Empty State
sections.description: EmptyDataCard before the first daytime sync.

stateMapping.empty: today == null or activity not ready

screens.name: Trends
screens.description: Trends, grouped: Scores (readiness heatmap, sleep score, activity) and Body (HRV, resting HR, daytime HR, temperature). Every card is full width with the same heading → chart anatomy.
notes: The seed has 7 synced days, so the heatmap renders one row and hrv/rhr have no prior week (no delta).
implementationHints: apps/mobile/src/app/trends.tsx. Averages skip unmeasured (0) days; a trend that is not ready renders a numeric 0 plus its unlock copy.

sections.name: Header
sections.description: Back, title, and a mint pill with the synced-day count.

sections.name: Empty Header
sections.description: Header without a right element before the first sync.

sections.description: No synced days yet.

sections.name: Readiness Heatmap
sections.description: White card under the Scores group: readiness heading with the 7-day average, 7-day heatmap.
implementationHints: Before readiness trendReady: numeric 0 + MATURITY_COPY.readiness.none.

sections.name: Sleep Score
sections.description: Penna card: sleep score heading with average, full-width 7-day line (first/last date ticks), average time asleep caption.

sections.name: Activity

sections.name: Body
sections.description: Body group: HRV (sage), resting HR (white), daytime HR (Penna), temperature (periwinkle) — each a full-width card with the value in the heading and a full-width 7-day line. Replaces the two-up tiles and the averages strip.

screens.name: Ring Debug
screens.description: Developer console for the ring link: wrapped ink command buttons, stored key/device meta line, and a log console that fills as commands run.
notes: Initial state before any command runs: no stored key or device, empty console.
implementationHints: apps/mobile/src/app/ring-debug.tsx. Buttons: ink fill, radius 10, padding 9/14, min height 48, 13pt semibold white system font; disabled 0.35, pressed 0.7.

sections.name: Header
sections.description: Back button and "Ring debug" title.

sections.name: Commands
sections.description: Wrapped DebugButtons in source order; Authenticate is disabled without a stored key, and every button disables while a command runs.

sections.name: Meta
sections.description: Stored auth key prefix and device id.
implementationHints: Shows "key: <first 8 hex>… · device: <id>" once paired.

sections.name: Console
sections.description: Log lines (Menlo 11pt ink) appended per command: "> label", "ok: label", "ERR label: message".

localValueExceptions.reason: DebugButton labels and the meta line set no fontFamily in ring-debug.tsx, so they render in the platform system font.
